title: Peptide Vial Label Roll Storage: Shelf Life Before Application
seoTitle: Peptide Label Roll Storage & Shelf Life | RP
description: Store unused peptide vial label rolls correctly, track material age and artwork revisions, and decide what to inspect before using older stock.
alt: AI-generated scene of printed RP peptide label rolls in protective packaging beside a stock card and humidity meter
caption: AI-generated packaging illustration: printed label rolls, protective bags and a receiving record. Readings and artwork are illustrative, not a storage specification or an actual factory record.
intro: The discount on a bigger print run is easy to see. The cost of the last three cartons sitting on a warm shelf is harder to put on the quote.
sources: Avery Dennison: storage of materials and finished labels

title: Peptide Vial Label Die-Cutting: Liner Strikes and Release Problems
seoTitle: Peptide Label Die-Cuts & Liner Strikes | RP
description: Distinguish label die-cut defects from adhesive and dispensing problems. Specify liner integrity, clean release and a useful converter investigation.
alt: AI-generated close-up of fully printed research vial labels with clean release and damaged backing under a loupe
caption: AI-generated inspection illustration: intact label release compared with damaged backing. The visible tear is illustrative and does not establish the cause of a production defect.
intro: A sharp-looking label can still stop an applicator. Before blaming the adhesive, turn the strip over and look at the backing.
sources: Wink: die-cutting guidance and thin-PET-liner white paper
Kocher+Beck: flexible dies and adhesive build-up

title: Supplement Label Barcode Verification: A Scan Is Not a Quality Report
description: Learn what a barcode verification report should cover, why a phone scan is not enough, and how to approve the printed code on your supplement package.
alt: AI-generated barcode inspection bench with a printed RP supplement label, optical measuring head and matching bottle
caption: AI-generated inspection scene, not a photograph of RP equipment or a verification certificate. The sample barcode and label copy are illustrative and must not be reused as production data.
intro: The phone reads it. Everyone relaxes. That is a useful check, but it is not the document a buyer should rely on to release a retail print run.
sources: GS1 Singapore: verification reports and complete-pack samples

title: Tapered Supplement Bottle Labels: Fix the Shape Before the Glue
seoTitle: Tapered Supplement Bottle Labels & Dielines | RP
description: Plan curved dielines for tapered supplement bottles. Measure both label boundaries, compare wrap and front-label options, and test fit before printing.
alt: AI-generated tapered supplement jars comparing a wrinkled trial label with a smooth fit beside a curved printed label
caption: AI-generated fit-trial illustration: a wrinkled wrap, a smoother fit and curved printed artwork. This is not a scale dieline; sample supplement copy is not an approved formulation or regulatory label.
intro: One end lines up. The other climbs toward the shoulder. More pressure may hide the wrinkle for the photograph, but it does not change the shape of the bottle.
sources: OnlineLabels: tapered-label geometry and measurement inputs
OnlineLabels: fitting labels to tapered containers

title: Serialized Hologram Labels: Reconcile Every Number Before Shipment
description: Specify serial-number control for custom hologram labels, including rejects, retained samples, reprints, roll manifests and shipment reconciliation.
alt: AI-generated serialized RP hologram labels with separate rejected and retained samples and a demo manifest
caption: AI-generated workflow illustration with demonstration serials and a demo manifest. It is not a production reconciliation record, a working authentication system or evidence of a security certification.
intro: A carton can contain the right number of labels and still contain the wrong serials. For a security job, the packing list is only half the handover.
sources: OpSec: product identities, activation and event history
